items.question: Which women, whether divine or demonic, entering that sight-path affect those proud of all erotic sentiment?
premises: The radiance extends up to the realm of Anaṅga.
Those proud of all erotic sentiment become susceptible to this radiance.
A woman entering that sight-path may be divine or demonic.
items.inference: Any woman, divine or demonic, who enters that sight-path affects those proud of all erotic sentiment.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of this verse as subject or object depends on the following verse not included here.
items.plain_english: A woman who comes into that path of sight—whether a goddess or a demoness—
